questions.learningObjective: Solve an exam-level problem in discrete mathematics from first principles.

stimulus.body: Solve the problem stated in the question using the relevant discrete-mathematics principle.

questions.stem: How many equivalence relations on 7 elements have exactly 4 classes? Give the exact answer.
questions.explanation: Equivalence relations correspond to partitions, so the count is the Stirling number S(7,4)=350. Choosing a subset would ignore how the other elements are grouped.
questions.hint: Equivalence classes form a set partition.
